title: printing-labs
description: Corporate gifting: catalog search, bulk GST pricing, quotes, meetings, HR welcome-kit automation.
summary: Corporate gifting: catalog search, bulk GST pricing, quotes, meetings, HR welcome-kit automation.
offersHint: Corporate gifting: catalog search, bulk GST pricing, quotes, meetings, HR welcome-kit automation. · Remote MCP (streamable-http) at https://printinglabs.com/mcp

toolsPreview.name: search-products
toolsPreview.description: Search Printing Labs' live corporate-gifting catalog (custom apparel, drinkware, welcome kits, bundles). Filter by free-text keyword, exact category, maximum unit price in INR, or bundles only. Returns matches with canonical product page URLs.

toolsPreview.name: get-product-details
toolsPreview.description: Full public details for one product or bundle by its permalink slug (from search-products results) or numeric id: description, pricing, bulk-discount tiers, GST rate, minimum order quantity, stock signal, and page URL.

toolsPreview.name: list-product-categories
toolsPreview.description: All Printing Labs catalog categories with live product counts and their canonical category page URLs, plus the preset-bundle count.

toolsPreview.name: get-company-info
toolsPreview.description: Verified facts about Printing Labs: services, fulfillment regions, budget-tier collections, seasonal gifting hubs, machine-readable resources, and how to contact or request a corporate quote.

toolsPreview.name: calculate-bulk-price
toolsPreview.description: Compute the effective bulk price for a given product and quantity: applies the product's quantity-discount tiers and GST, validates the minimum order quantity, and shows the next discount tier. Indicative pricing — final quotes come from the sales team.

toolsPreview.name: list-catalogs
toolsPreview.description: The downloadable PDF catalogue library: every published catalogue with its title, description, page count, file size, and direct PDF URL.

toolsPreview.name: get-site-info
toolsPreview.description: Look up how Printing Labs actually works: answers from the published FAQ, what each in-house tool does (Mockup Studio, Brand Stores, Campaign Planner, Build Box, Swag Drop), the list of public pages, and headline return/shipping/terms/privacy facts with the page carrying the binding version. Use this instead of guessing when a customer asks 'what is X' or 'how does Y work'.

toolsPreview.name: request-quote
toolsPreview.description: Submit a corporate quote request to the Printing Labs sales team on the user's behalf. Creates a real lead: the team receives it instantly (CRM + email + WhatsApp) and the requester gets a confirmation email. Only submit with the user's explicit consent and their real contact details.

toolsPreview.name: cancel-meeting
toolsPreview.description: Cancel a meeting you booked earlier in this conversation. Requires the manageToken returned by book-meeting — the same token that powers the cancel link in the customer's confirmation email. Removes the Google Calendar event and notifies both sides.

toolsPreview.name: reschedule-meeting
toolsPreview.description: Move a meeting you booked earlier in this conversation to a new slot. Requires the manageToken from book-meeting. Check availability with get-meeting-slots first; the Google Calendar event is moved and both sides are notified.

toolsPreview.name: request-callback
toolsPreview.description: Ask the Printing Labs sales team to call the customer back. Creates a real callback request that reaches the team immediately (CRM + email + WhatsApp). Use when someone wants to speak to a human, or when a voice call needs a follow-up. Only submit with the customer's explicit consent and their real number.

toolsPreview.name: raise-complaint
toolsPreview.description: File a complaint for a customer who is unhappy with something Printing Labs did — a late or wrong delivery, a quality problem, a billing error, a request nobody answered. Creates a real ticket: the customer is acknowledged by email (and WhatsApp when possible) with a reference, the team that can actually fix it is alerted, and a task with a deadline lands on their board. Use it the moment somebody complains; do NOT use it for a question, a quote chase or a price negotiation.

toolsPreview.name: get-meeting-slots
toolsPreview.description: Available consultation slots (IST) with the Printing Labs team for a given date. Use before book-meeting; slots reflect the live calendar.

toolsPreview.name: book-meeting
toolsPreview.description: Book a consultation with the Printing Labs team: creates the Google Calendar event (with Meet link unless Phone Call), registers the meeting, and emails the requester confirm/reschedule/cancel links. The time must be one of get-meeting-slots' values for that date. Only book with the user's explicit consent and their real contact details.

toolsPreview.name: track-order
toolsPreview.description: Live status timeline for an existing order. Requires the order id AND the email the order was placed with (both must match).

toolsPreview.name: create-onboarding-drop
toolsPreview.description: HR/HRIS automation (requires an API key in the Authorization header — Bearer plk_…): turn new hires into welcome-kit claim links in one call. Creates a Swag Drop for the chosen kit, invites each employee by email, and returns the claim + HR dashboard links. Each employee picks their own size and delivery address; Printing Labs prints, packs and ships per recipient.
